headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 25, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, with Junior Caminero leading the Royals' offense with 3 hits and 3 home runs. Ian Seymour pitched 6.2 scoreless innings for the Rays. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Brandon Lowe leading the Mariners' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The Athletics took down the San Francisco Giants 9-6, with Victor Bericoto leading the team at the plate.

Several players have been affected by injuries, with Ryne Nelson being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow. Johan Rojas has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right elbow UCL repair, while Cody Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 22, 2026, with a herniated disc. Marcus Semien has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hip flexor strain, and Zack Gelof has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 24, 2026, with a right hand contusion.

The Chicago Cubs have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher David Peterson, acquired in a trade. The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later, while the Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash. The Houston Astros also traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Rays in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, handing them a one-sided loss. Junior Caminero led the Royals' offense with 3 hits and 3 home runs, while Ian Seymour pitched 6.2 scoreless innings for the Rays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, ending their opponent's winning streak. Brandon Lowe led the Mariners' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Giants 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Victor Bericoto leading the team at the plate. Bericoto hit 1 home run and drove in 2 runs, while Landen Roupp pitched 6 strong innings with 6 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Astros Edge Tigers in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros took down the Detroit Tigers 2-1, with Tatsuya Imai earning the win after 6.0 innings of scoreless relief. Enyel De Los Santos secured the save.

top_news.title: **Ryne Nelson Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Ryne Nelson has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Lefty David Peterson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher David Peterson, acquired in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being dealt from his previous team.
